1. [Hallway] Write Caddy's configuration, routing *.localhost to your apps and https://hallway.localhost to the dashboard, and check it with `caddy validate`
     /home/me/.hallway/generated/caddy.json
     /home/me/.hallway/generated/fallback.html
2. [Hallway] Run Caddy as you, on 127.0.0.1:4443 and :4480, as a LaunchAgent (hallway.caddy), with its admin API on a private socket
     /home/me/.hallway/state/caddy/admin.sock
3. [sudo] Trust Hallway's local certificate authority in the System keychain, so browsers accept its certificates
     $ sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain /home/me/.hallway/state/caddy/data/pki/authorities/local/root.crt
4. [sudo] Redirect loopback ports 443 and 80 to Caddy on 4443 and 4480 (a pf anchor, loaded at boot by the hallway.pf LaunchDaemon)
     writes /home/me/.hallway/generated/setup/pf.anchor, installed as /etc/pf.anchors/hallway:
       | # Written by `hallway setup`; removed by `hallway teardown`.
       | # Loaded into the com.apple/hallway anchor by the hallway.pf LaunchDaemon. Connections to loopback ports 443 and
       | # 80 go to Hallway's Caddy, which runs as you on 4443 and 4480. Only loopback traffic is touched.
       | rdr pass on lo0 inet proto tcp from any to 127.0.0.1 port 443 -> 127.0.0.1 port 4443
       | rdr pass on lo0 inet proto tcp from any to 127.0.0.1 port 80 -> 127.0.0.1 port 4480
       | rdr pass on lo0 inet6 proto tcp from any to ::1 port 443 -> ::1 port 4443
       | rdr pass on lo0 inet6 proto tcp from any to ::1 port 80 -> ::1 port 4480
     writes /home/me/.hallway/generated/setup/hallway.pf.plist, installed as /Library/LaunchDaemons/hallway.pf.plist:
       | <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
       | <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
       | <!-- Written by `hallway setup`; removed by `hallway teardown`. It loads one fixed pf anchor at boot and exits; it reads nothing a user can write. -->
       | <plist version="1.0">
       | <dict>
       |   <key>Label</key>
       |   <string>hallway.pf</string>
       |   <key>ProgramArguments</key>
       |   <array>
       |     <string>/sbin/pfctl</string>
       |     <string>-E</string>
       |     <string>-a</string>
       |     <string>com.apple/hallway</string>
       |     <string>-f</string>
       |     <string>/etc/pf.anchors/hallway</string>
       |   </array>
       |   <key>RunAtLoad</key>
       |   <true/>
       | </dict>
       | </plist>
     $ sudo install -m 0644 -o root -g wheel /home/me/.hallway/generated/setup/pf.anchor /etc/pf.anchors/hallway
     $ sudo install -m 0644 -o root -g wheel /home/me/.hallway/generated/setup/hallway.pf.plist /Library/LaunchDaemons/hallway.pf.plist
     $ sudo launchctl bootout system/hallway.pf   (may fail harmlessly)
     $ sudo launchctl bootstrap system /Library/LaunchDaemons/hallway.pf.plist
5. [Hallway] Switch config.yaml to fronted mode: links become https://<app>.localhost
6. [Hallway] Check https://hallway.localhost answers through the redirect, with Hallway's certificate

Nothing was run. `hallway setup` runs these, asking for your password through sudo where it says sudo.
